title: Tip from Angela - Location, Location, Location!
summary: A short learning-habits talk about the gap between following a tutorial and building alone, and the confidence curve most learners go through. No code is covered.

concepts.heading: Key takeaways
points: Understanding a demo while watching is not the same as being able to reproduce it. Skill comes from doing the work yourself.
Suggested routine: watch for the overall idea, jot down function names and tools you may need, then pause the video and attempt the exercise on your own before seeing the solution.

Early on, new learners often overestimate what they know (the Dunning-Kruger effect). As knowledge grows, the gaps become visible and confidence drops into a low point, often experienced as impostor syndrome.
Both extremes are distortions; the realistic position is somewhere between. Consistent practice and applying what is learned is what moves you forward.

pitfalls: Treating passive video watching as learning and skipping the pause-and-try step.
